held.reason: The design system draws a disabled button as a plain bordered button with muted text. The app also fades every disabled control to 50% (components.css), so taking this rule would show a disabled button lighter than any board draws it, on Add a computer and New agent. The owner chose to keep the app look (2026-11-13); the board is to be changed to match.
